name: udyam-erp
description: UDYAM — Business Operations & Inventory ERP (Full-Stack PERN Application)

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.deploy: npm run install:all && npm run build:client && npm run db:setup && npm start
scripts.vercel-build: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build

author: Bandla Santosh Krishna
